title: Metabolic modelling with machine learning links amino acids to P. syringae colonization
summary: A 100-member ensemble of genome-scale metabolic reconstructions (iPst19) was constrained with expression data from naive and pre-immunized infected plants, and machine-learning analysis of the simulations found that branched-chain amino acid metabolism contributed to the metabolic state. Experiments showed that excess BCAAs suppressed virulence gene expression and impaired Arabidopsis leaf colonization. The machine-learning method is unnamed in the abstract and is one step of a larger modelling pipeline.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of ensemble genome-scale metabolic model simulations

evidence.tested: Growth, gene-expression and in planta colonization experiments.
evidence.unknown: Which machine-learning method was used; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning highlighted BCAA metabolism in the simulations.
